subject: platform/analytics
auditor: agent session (Claude), quality sample round, see run record
professional: a senior web-analytics / privacy engineer who sets up Cloudflare Web Analytics and site measurement; they check first that the provisioning calls the documented RUM API correctly and idempotently, that the beacon tag is the vendor's snippet with a validated token, deferred, injected once and carrying no PII, that CSP and consent implications are handled, and that the legal copy tracks what actually ships

evidence.correctness: Ran an independent script (scratchpad wa/check.mjs) against the shipped functions. beaconTag gives `<script defer src="https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js" data-cf-beacon='{"token": "<32 hex>"}'></script>`, which matches Cloudflare's documented manual-install snippet (from memory: developers.cloudflare.com is not reachable from this session); token lower-cased, and a value like `x' onload='alert(1)` is refused. Injection lands before an upper-case </BODY>, appends when there is no </body>, skips fragments, and injectDir on a hand-built tree (2 documents, 1 fragment .html, 1 .htm) reports {changed:2, seen:3}, as counted by hand. The RUM endpoints GET /accounts/{id}/rum/site_info/list and POST /accounts/{id}/rum/site_info with {host, auto_install} and the site_token / ruleset.zone_name fields match my memory of Cloudflare's API reference; the author states they were never checked against it or run live. Two fails: with the host on page 2 of the list (result_info.total_pages 2) provision POSTs a duplicate site instead of finding it (provision.mjs:49 reads one page only); a `</body>` in a script after the real one receives the tag inside the string (0 of 4,513 venture HTML files have that shape, scan.mjs).
evidence.completeness: README features checked: site.json host/token (present, token empty); provision.mjs find-or-create plus GITHUB_OUTPUT (works against mocks; GITHUB_OUTPUT got `token=` with no credentials, exit 0); 'Never fails a deploy' (false: a malformed committed token exits 1, check below); web-analytics.mjs CLI injection, idempotent (1 of 1, then 0 of 1); the workflow wiring (priv-portfolio-pages.yml:284-307 own job with sparse checkout, build gets the output at :436, late pages at :524-528); build.mjs gates the legal copy on analyticsOn() (build.mjs:10781-10783, 13542, 14283). Not done end to end: no token exists (site.json:4, asks.yaml web-analytics-token open), so no page carries the beacon; the served site could not be loaded to confirm (proxy 403 on marisstella.app). README 'Next' (pull the numbers into the repo) not started.
evidence.verification: `node --test '*.test.mjs'` in platform/analytics: 9 pass, 0 fail (~80 ms); the suite also runs in portfolio-validate.yml:199. Five seeded mutants via quality_mutate.py: idempotency guard removed (caught), auto_install flipped (caught), lastIndexOf -> indexOf (survived), token regex {32} -> {32,} (survived: 33+ hex characters accepted), CLI ignores committed site.json token (survived: neither script's CLI path is tested).
evidence.craft: Read README.md, provision.mjs, web-analytics.mjs, web-analytics.test.mjs, site.json, the workflow job and the build.mjs call sites. Small, readable, dependency-free; credentials isolated in their own job so only the public token reaches the build; tokens validated before splicing into thousands of pages; fetch injected for tests; failures logged and tried against the next token. Defects: the CLI blocks run unguarded top-level code that throws on a bad committed token; BEACON_HOSTS (web-analytics.mjs:14) is exported and used nowhere; pagination ignored.
evidence.claims: Backed: 'cookieless, no consent banner' (Cloudflare documents Web Analytics as setting no cookies or local storage, from memory; privacy-baseline.md cited); 'only the public site token reaches the build' (workflow :284-307, :436); 'idempotent' (ran twice: 1 then 0 pages changed); 'with no token none of them [legal pages] do' (legal-pages.mjs:59, 278, 333 and build.mjs:8267 all gated on analyticsOn()); 'written without access to Cloudflare's API reference' (honest, README:44-46). What is measured (page views, visits, referrers, countries, devices, browsers, Core Web Vitals) matches the vendor's product as I know it. Not backed: README:18 and provision.mjs:16-17 'Never fails a deploy' / 'every failure ... exits 0': a malformed token in site.json makes provision.mjs exit 1, which fails the web-analytics job the build job needs.
evidence.fitness: Job: could the repository's runs rely on this to measure usage? Not today. site.json has no token and the deploy token most likely cannot provision (asks.yaml web-analytics-token, opened 2026-11-25), so no page carries the beacon; even when it does, the numbers stay in the Cloudflare dashboard: nothing pulls them into portfolio/usage/ for a run to read (README:57-59 lists it as Next). The first-party counter (platform/counter) remains the only usage reading a run can consume.
evidence.domain: Compared with Cloudflare Web Analytics' manual-install practice: the documented snippet, deferred, before </body>, one per page, public token; cookieless vendor chosen so no consent banner under ePrivacy/PECR; identifier-based funnels explicitly left to consented product analytics (README:60-62); legal copy switches with the beacon. Departures: list pagination not followed (duplicate sites possible); no CSP guidance (the site sets no CSP today, but adding one needs script-src static.cloudflareinsights.com and connect-src cloudflareinsights.com, which the unused BEACON_HOSTS hints at); for a hostname on a Cloudflare zone the dashboard's usual route is auto-install by zone_tag, not a manual host site: not wrong, but unverified.

defects.what: A malformed token committed to site.json makes provision.mjs throw and exit 1, failing the web-analytics job that the build job needs, so the whole deploy stops; README:18 and provision.mjs:16-17 promise every failure exits 0 and a deploy never fails over analytics. The README invites any session to paste the token by hand, so a typo is the likely path.
Nothing measures usage yet: site.json has no token, the deploy token most likely cannot provision, and no puller brings Web Analytics numbers into portfolio/usage/, so no run can read them.
The RUM site list is read one page (per_page=100) without following result_info.total_pages; a host beyond page 1 is not found and a duplicate Web Analytics site is created on every deploy.
Neither CLI path is tested, nor the last-</body> choice nor the exact token length: three of five seeded mutants survived.
lastIndexOf('</body>') puts the tag inside a script string when a script after the real </body> contains that text (no venture page has the shape today).
BEACON_HOSTS is exported and used nowhere; no note says a future CSP must allow script-src static.cloudflareinsights.com and connect-src cloudflareinsights.com.

verdict: Below the bar (claims 2, verification 2, median 2) and not finished (completeness 2). The beacon half is senior-grade: the vendor's snippet, deferred, validated token, idempotent, credentials kept out of the build job, and legal copy that switches with the beacon; every injector output recomputed by hand matched. The provisioning half has never run against Cloudflare (the author says so), ignores list pagination, and breaks its own 'never fails a deploy' promise when site.json holds a malformed token (provision.mjs:67, exit 1). For the platform's real job, measuring usage, it delivers nothing yet: no token, no beacon live, and no reader that brings the numbers into the repository. Smallest safe fix: catch the normaliseToken error in provision.mjs's CLI, log it and fall back to the API, with a test that a bad committed token yields '' and exit 0.
